scope: De-identified expert review summary for the reviewed prescription library
review_target: Candidate prescription entries for four actionable wheat pest and disease categories
disagreement_resolution: Entries with disagreement were rechecked by at least two experts against the original source and disputed fields. If agreement could not be reached, the conservative decision was used and the entry was not accepted unless target, dosage, PHI, timing, and source support were clear.
public_release_boundary: This summary is de-identified. Controlled item-level review materials can be provided if the editor requires inspection during peer review.
